about: Burst sequences for the team pages. Each set is one car photographed three times in about two seconds from the same spot on the outside of a slow corner at Zandvoort, Friday 21 August 2026 (Dutch Grand Prix weekend), by Steffen Prößdorf, CC BY-SA 4.0. The car comes in heading right, turns towards the camera and leaves heading left.
author: Steffen Prößdorf
